title: Entra ID Global Administrator Role Assigned
expression: properties.category == 'RoleManagement' && operationName == 'Add member to role' && contains(to_string(properties.targetResources), 'Global Administrator')

title: Entra ID Global Administrator Role Assigned (PIM User)
expression: properties.category == 'RoleManagement' && (operationName == 'Add eligible member to role in PIM completed (permanent)' || operationName == 'Add member to role in PIM completed (timebound)') && contains(to_string(properties.targetResources), 'Global Administrator')

title: Entra ID Outlook Non-Edge Browser Sign-In
expression: operationName == 'Sign-in activity' && properties.appDisplayName == 'Microsoft Outlook' && properties.deviceDetail.browser != null && !starts_with(to_string(properties.deviceDetail.browser), 'Edge')
